The following events took place in '''13 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The lost [[Human/Legends|Human]] colony of [[Renatasia system/Legends|Renatasia]] is rediscovered in a rarely-visited section of the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]].<ref name="NEC101" />
*[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] won the [[Junior Championship Division|junior]] [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racing]] championship of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] for the first time.<ref name="TPS">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref>

[[File:Jem_ysanna.jpg|thumb|Jem Ysanna is born.]]

*[[Ambush at Vale]]<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Births==
*[[Jem Ysanna]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]<ref name="DB-Ysanna, Jem">{{DB|character|jemysanna|Ysanna, Jem}}</ref>
*[[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]<ref name="Galaxy of Fear: Eaten Alive">''[[Galaxy of Fear: Eaten Alive]]''</ref>
*[[Danielle Kieran]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]<ref name="Age">Danielle Kieran is established to be 17 standard years old during the events of "[[The Luminous Bantha: Adventures for the Star Wars: New Republic Campaign]]," which takes place after the events of {{Film|VI}}. As the events of ''Return of the Jedi'' are established to take place in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] as per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', Kieran must have been born around [[13 BBY/Legends|13 BBY]].</ref>
*[[Durrei]] on [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]]<ref name="Relic">{{JournalCite|6|Relic (article)}}</ref>
*[[Marcus Sione]] on [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
*[[Yuri Stonelaw]]<ref name="The Draw">{{JournalCite|15|The Draw}}</ref>
*[[Bron Dooku]]<ref name="AotE6">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 1|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 1]] based on him being ten years old in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]]</ref>
*[[Zeth Durron]]<ref name="birth">In [[Dark Apprentice (novel)|''Dark Apprentice'']], Kyp Durron is eighteen years old. Since ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the book to [[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]], he was born in [[7 BBY/Legends|7 BBY]]. ''[[Jedi Search]]'' establishes that [[Zeth Durron]] was fourteen when Kyp was eight. Since he is six years older than his brother, who was born in 7 BBY, Zeth himself was born in 13 BBY.</ref>
